bundle.longDescription: RustMusic is a free, open-source desktop music player built for audiophiles. It plays FLAC, ALAC, WAV, AIFF, MP3 and DSD (DSF/DFF) files with bit-perfect exclusive output, native DSD over DoP, gapless playback and ReplayGain. It manages large libraries with a fast tag workshop (MusicBrainz and Deezer lookups), synced lyrics and a built-in DLNA server, plays to UPnP/DLNA and AirPlay devices, and can act as a remote for Onkyo, Pioneer, Denon, Marantz and Yamaha amplifiers.
bundle.shortDescription: Audiophile music player with native DSD, bit-perfect output and network playback
